messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Hindi, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Hindi line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑by‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation | Status | |-------------|----------------------|----------------------|------------------|--------| | Ond' | causal conjunction “wherefore” | इसलिए | therefore | OK | | io | 1st‑person singular subject | मैं | I | OK | | per | preposition “for” (benefactive) | के लिये | for | OK | | lo | definite article (neuter) | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | tuo | 2nd‑person possessive “thy” | तुम्हारे | your | OK | | me' | abstract noun “best / good” | हित | good, benefit | OK | | penso | verb “think” | सोचता | think | OK | | e | coordinating conjunction “and” | और | and | OK | | discerno | verb “deem / judge” | निर्णय लेता हूँ | decide, deem | OK | | che | subordinating conjunction “that” | कि | that | OK | | tu | 2nd‑person singular subject | तुम | you | OK | | mi | 1st‑person object “me” | मेरा | my (object) | OK | | segui | verb “follow” | अनुसरण करो | follow (imperative) | OK | | e | coordinating conjunction “and” | और | and | OK | | io | 1st‑person singular subject | मैं | I | OK | | sarò | future copula “will be” | बनूँगा | will become | OK | | tua | 2nd‑person possessive “thy” | तुम्हारा | your | OK | | guida | noun “guide” | मार्गदर्शक | guide | OK | | e | coordinating conjunction “and” | और | and | OK | | trarrotti | future transitive “will lead you” | ले जाऊँगा | will lead | OK | | di | preposition “from” | से | from | OK | | qui | adverb “here” | यहाँ | here | OK | | per | preposition “through / toward” | की ओर | toward | OK | | loco | noun “place” | स्थान | place | OK | | etterno | adjective “eternal” | अनन्त | eternal | OK |
### Items Requiring Attention - **UNNECESSARY**: *lo* – the definite article has no counterpart in Hindi and is naturally omitted.
No other source words are missing, wrong, or cause grammatical disagreement.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Hindi script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Hindi text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- **Line 112** - Original: इसलिए मैं तुम्हारे हित के लिये सोचता और निर्णय लेता हूँ कि तुम मेरा अनुसरण करो - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
- **Line 113** - Original: कि तुम मेरा अनुसरण करो और मैं तुम्हारा मार्गदर्शक बनूँगा, - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
- **Line 114** - Original: और मैं तुम्हें यहाँ से अनन्त स्थान की ओर ले जाऊँगा; - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
